branch: .ef-label sits on the same left rail as a .pi-title, and its icon on the same axis as .pi-ic
provenance: Pure CSS geometry — no wire frames, so this fixture asserts only what the STYLESHEET must produce, never anything about the CLI. SELECTOR SCOPED 2026-08-24: `.popup-f .ef-label` became ambiguous when the model menu grew its own .popup-f footer (fixture 55) — the bare selector matched the CLOSED model menu's label first (0x0 rects, glyph 0) and all four asserts failed; `#modeMenu .popup-f .ef-label` restores the original measurement, contract unchanged. User report 2026-08-16 (screenshot with a rule drawn down the mode titles): the Effort label sat left of them. THE ARITHMETIC, measured in the real panel 2026-08-17: a mode title starts at 14px popup padding + a 20px .pi-ic slot + a 10px gap = 44. Pre-fix the label was 14 + an 18px svg + an 8px gap = 40, i.e. 4px adrift — NOT the 7px first reported, which came from a headless probe page that lacked the #inputbar ancestor. That matters here: `#inputbar svg { width:18px; height:18px }` is an ID rule and BEATS both `.ef-label svg { width:15px; height:15px }` and `.pi-ic svg { 17px }`, so those declared sizes are dead inside the composer and every icon there renders 18px. The fix works because flex-basis is a property the ID rule does not set: `flex: 0 0 20px` gives the svg the same 20px slot .pi-ic occupies, so text and icon axis both line up while the glyph stays 18. The menu is opened by CLICKING THE CHIP, not by adding .show by hand — a force-shown popup skips tg()'s positioning (2026-08-16 gotcha) — and closeMenus() runs inside the same setup so a failure cannot leave the menu open over later fixtures. Deltas are rounded: the panel sits at a fractional x, so raw lefts carry .39px and only the DIFFERENCE is exact. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-17 against commit 4e351f4's chat.css (the last 8px-gap build): the three DISCRIMINATING assertions failed with textDelta -4, iconDelta -1, svgSlot 18; both positional GUARDs passed, and the glyph guard read 18 in both builds as it must. ADDED 2026-08-19 (step 2): user screenshot — 'Very High' wrapped to two lines in the footer with the row half empty. Measured live over CDP: JCEF gives the <b>'s flex base 53px against a 55px max-content, so only the one two-word level wrapped; desktop Chrome on the same markup+CSS keeps it to one line, so design/mockup.html could never show it. Fix is a single declaration — white-space: nowrap on .ef-label. NEGATIVE CONTROL 2026-08-19: step 2 was RUN against the sandbox still serving the pre-fix chat.css (started before the fix landed): the discriminating assertion failed with bH 37; after a restart on the fixed stylesheet it reads 19 and passes.

steps.note: the mode menu's footer label shares the mode titles' rail
steps.setup: window.__rail = (function () { document.getElementById('modeChip').click(); const pop = document.getElementById('modeMenu'); const title = document.querySelector('#modeItems .pi-title').getBoundingClientRect(); const ic = document.querySelector('#modeItems .pi-ic').getBoundingClientRect(); const lbl = document.querySelector('#modeMenu .popup-f .ef-label'); const svg = lbl.querySelector('svg').getBoundingClientRect(); let textLeft = null; for (const n of lbl.childNodes) if (n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim()) {   const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(n);   textLeft = r.getBoundingClientRect().left; break; } const out = { shown: pop.classList.contains('show'), display: getComputedStyle(pop).display,   titleLeft: title.left, textLeft: textLeft,   textDelta: Math.round(textLeft - title.left),   iconDelta: Math.round((svg.left + svg.width / 2) - (ic.left + ic.width / 2)),   svgSlot: Math.round(svg.width), glyph: Math.round(svg.height) }; closeMenus(); return out;})();

expect.why: GUARD: the popup is really laid out — every measurement below is void otherwise
GUARD: and positioned, so these are real rects and not a collapsed 0x0
DISCRIMINATING: 'Effort' starts exactly where a mode title starts (-4 pre-fix)
DISCRIMINATING: and its icon centres on the mode icons' axis (-1 pre-fix)
DISCRIMINATING: the svg takes a 20px slot via flex-basis (18 pre-fix)
GUARD: the GLYPH is 18px in BOTH builds — it comes from `#inputbar svg` (ID beats .ef-label svg), so the fix must not have resized the icon
GUARD: the menu was closed again, so it cannot cover a later fixture's assertions

steps.note: the longest effort label renders on one line
steps.setup: window.__wrap = (function () { document.getElementById('modeChip').click(); const pop = document.getElementById('modeMenu'); const nameEl = document.getElementById('efName'); const prev = efDots.findIndex(function (d) { return d.classList.contains('cur'); }); setEffortUI(3); const r = nameEl.getBoundingClientRect(); const out = { display: getComputedStyle(pop).display, label: nameEl.textContent, bH: Math.round(r.height), bW: Math.round(r.width) }; setEffortUI(prev >= 0 ? prev : 2); out.restored = nameEl.textContent; closeMenus(); return out; })();
